subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Himachal Pradesh.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Shimla (Summer), Dharamshala (Winter). Himachal Pradesh covers a geographic area of 55,673 sq km across 12 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Chenab, Ravi, Beas, Sutlej, Yamuna.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Known as 'Dev Bhoomi' (Land of the Gods). Features high-altitude Himalayan terrain, fruit cultivation ('Apple State of India'), and Dalai Lama's central residence at McLeod Ganj.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Himachal Pradesh.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Himachal Pradesh was formally instituted on 25 January 1971. Official language(s): Hindi.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Nati (Guinness World Record folk dance), Chham, Rakshasa dance.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Kullu Dussehra, Minjar Fair, Fagli, Losar.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Himachal Pradesh.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Shiv Pratap Shukla.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh is Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Himachal Pradesh High Court (Shimla).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Snow leopard | State Bird: Western tragopan | State Flower: Pink rhododendron | State Tree: Deodar cedar.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Himachal Pradesh.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Limestone, Gypsum, Rock Salt (Mandi), Barite.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Himachal Pradesh plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Himachal Pradesh.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Kalka-Shimla Toy Train (UNESCO), Hidimba Devi Temple (Manali), Kangra Fort, Tabo Monastery.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Great Himalayan National Park (UNESCO), Pin Valley National Park, Khirganga National Park.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Himachal Pradesh.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh Samman Nidhi, Mukhya Mantri Swavlamban Yojana.
